result.summary: Mostly made of ABS plastic housings, foam cushions, and internal speaker drivers with electronic components.

parts.name: Ear cushion
parts.process_detail: Polyurethane foam is moulded then wrapped with synthetic leather cover and sewn.
parts.fun_fact: Memory foam was originally developed by NASA in 1966 for aircraft cushions.

parts.name: Ear cup housing
parts.process_detail: Molten ABS is injected into a mold cavity and cooled to form the shell.
parts.fun_fact: ABS plastic is the same material used in LEGO bricks for its durability.

parts.name: Headband
parts.process_detail: Plastic frame is injection moulded then padded with foam and covered with fabric.
parts.fun_fact: Headbands often contain spring steel inside for tension that lasts thousands of flexes.

parts.name: Hinge mechanism
parts.process_detail: Hinge parts are injection moulded with precise tolerances for smooth rotation and adjustment.
parts.fun_fact: Quality headphone hinges are tested to withstand over 10,000 folding cycles.

parts.name: Speaker driver
parts.process_detail: Voice coil, diaphragm, and magnet are assembled with precise alignment for sound quality.
parts.fun_fact: Neodymium magnets are the strongest permanent magnets commercially available, enabling compact powerful drivers.

parts.name: PCB circuit board
parts.process_detail: Components are soldered onto printed circuit board using automated pick and place machines.
parts.fun_fact: Modern Bluetooth headphone PCBs can contain over 100 components in a space smaller than a coin.

parts.name: Control button
parts.process_detail: Silicone is heated and pressed into a mold to form the button pad.
parts.fun_fact: Silicone buttons are rated for millions of presses without losing their tactile feel.

parts.name: Lithium battery
parts.process_detail: Lithium polymer layers are stacked, sealed in foil pouch, and fitted with protection circuit.
parts.fun_fact: Lithium polymer batteries can be shaped to fit tight spaces unlike rigid cylindrical cells.

journey.title: Plastic pellets sourced
journey.detail: ABS and polycarbonate pellets are produced from petroleum derivatives at chemical plants.

journey.title: Components manufactured
journey.detail: Housings are injection moulded, drivers assembled, PCBs populated, and batteries packaged at suppliers.

journey.title: Headphones assembled
journey.detail: All parts are brought together on assembly line with wiring, soldering, and fitting.

journey.title: Quality testing
journey.detail: Each unit is tested for sound quality, Bluetooth connectivity, and battery performance.

journey.title: Packaged and shipped
journey.detail: Headphones are boxed with accessories and shipped in bulk to distribution centers worldwide.

journey.title: Delivered to buyer
journey.detail: Final delivery from warehouse or retail store to the customer's home or office.
